title: Cloud-6 QA: sign-in (OneAPI, classic, SSO), secret masking, remembered secrets, audit log, owner-only files, ZIA rate pacing

coverage.note: line+branch over the nine files, measured with coverage --branch on the same test subset (auth, SSO, secret canaries, rate, profiles, fingerprint, Secure-by-Design and regression tests) before and after; after adds tests/test_c6_auth.py

checks.what: UI token compared with secrets.compare_digest on bytes; non-ASCII is a 401
UI cookie HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Secure over HTTPS, 12 h; SSO session and login cookies HttpOnly, Lax, Secure over HTTPS, login cookie path-scoped (existing tests rechecked)
State single-use and bound to the browser, nonce checked (constant time), PKCE S256
Issuer, audience/azp, expiry, iat, algorithm allow-list pinned to the JWK, no 'none' or HS*
Discovery issuer must match, endpoints https or loopback; issuer prefix bypass closed
Pending sign-ins from the open login route bounded and locked
An unverified email never grants writer rights
ZSCALER_SSO_WRITERS by group or verified email, case-insensitive (existing tests rechecked)
Credential store by default; plaintext only with DLP_CHECK_SECRET_STORE=file in an owner-only file
Forgetting or deleting removes the secret from the store and the file (and last-good copy)
A hold is saved and still held after a restart
Every pacing sleep is positive, through holds and full buckets
Pacing, holds and messages use the injected _now/_sleep
A damaged state file costs only its bad entries; clock set back waits one window
Typed, URL, every-byte %, JSON, base64, Basic pair, partial (8+), bearer, URL-encoded bearer, JWT, OAuth token fields, JSESSIONID
Token redaction linear on hostile input
O_APPEND; earlier lines never rewritten
Rolled at MAX_MB (bounded 1..1024 MB, bad values default), two files at most
0600 tightened per line, O_NOFOLLOW
write_private_atomic: unguessable mkstemp temp, os.replace replaces a planted link, 0600
private_open never follows a link at the name
Only stored/deflate members, encrypted refused, declared and actual size bounded, damaged member refused
SDK errors token- and secret-masked in results and logs

Verified against zscaler 1.11.3: LegacyZIAClientHelper.deauthenticate (zia/legacy.py:420), oneapi_client.Client.__exit__, OneAPI token request posts client_secret as a form field (oneapi_oauth_client.py:298) so HTTP Basic masking is defence in depth
A vanity domain that is not a DNS name never reaches the SDK sign-in

findings.title: Redacting a JSON Web Token took quadratic time: an echoed error with a long '-eyJ-eyJ…' run (80 KB: 2 s, 200 KB: 12 s) held the job thread
findings.fix: Find JWTs per run of token characters, each dot-separated part once (linear), with the old pattern as the test oracle

findings.title: mask_secrets missed a secret echoed base64-encoded, as HTTP Basic 'id:secret', or percent-encoded byte by byte
findings.fix: secret_forms adds base64 and every-byte percent forms; mask_secrets masks Basic pairs of client_id/client_secret and username/password

findings.title: mask_secrets left a partial secret visible when an echo was cut short ('…secret=S3cr3t-Val…')
findings.fix: Any run of 8+ characters of a secret's typed, URL or JSON form is masked (base64 only whole)

findings.title: redact_tokens missed a URL-encoded bearer (Bearer%20…), OAuth access/refresh/id_token fields and HTTP Basic credentials
findings.fix: URL-encoded separators, token-field and Basic patterns (Basic only when it decodes to an 'id:secret' pair)

findings.title: A Retry-After header too large for a float raised OverflowError in the classic API's 429 handling
findings.fix: Retry-After capped at a week (still RetryTooLong), NaN is the default

findings.title: SSO took the ID token's algorithm from its own header, not pinned to the published key's (PS256 accepted for an RS256 key; 'none'/HS256 refused only by library accident)
findings.fix: Allow-list of public-key algorithms, which must equal the JWK's alg; kty and use checked

findings.title: SSO accepted an ID token with no expiry (or no iat or sub): a sign-in token valid for ever
findings.fix: exp, iat, iss, aud, sub required (OIDC Core 3.1.3.7), 60 s leeway, plain-language errors

findings.title: The https requirement for ZSCALER_SSO_ISSUER was bypassed by http://localhost.attacker.example (prefix test)
findings.fix: secure_url compares the parsed host to loopback names exactly

findings.title: Pending SSO sign-ins grew without bound from the unauthenticated login route, and were swept without a lock
findings.fix: MAX_PENDING_LOGINS (oldest dropped) under _PENDING_LOCK

findings.title: ZSCALER_SSO_IDLE_MINUTES=inf raised OverflowError on every signed-in request
findings.fix: Non-finite is the default; bounded to 1 min..12 h

findings.title: SSO did not check azp for a multi-audience ID token, the discovery document's issuer, or plain-http endpoints in it
findings.fix: azp must be this client when several audiences or azp present; discovery issuer must match; endpoints https or loopback

findings.title: DLP_CHECK_AUDIT_MAX_MB=inf made audit.record raise (an audited request then failed); 0 or less rolled, so lost, the log on every line
findings.fix: audit.max_bytes: positive finite, default 20, at most 1024 MB

findings.title: The audit log followed a symbolic link planted at its name and never tightened a log made wider than 0600
findings.fix: O_NOFOLLOW on open, fchmod 0600 on every line

findings.title: Audit lines wrote request-body key names whole (a megabyte key per request) and unmasked
findings.fix: Key names masked like values and cut at 64 characters

findings.title: audit.tail(0) or a negative count returned the whole log
findings.fix: n of 0 or less, or not a number, is no entries

findings.title: safe_files.private_open wrote through a symbolic link planted at the file's name
findings.fix: O_NOFOLLOW on every private_open

findings.title: strict_json_loads raised RecursionError, not the documented ValueError, for deeply nested JSON
findings.fix: RecursionError re-raised as ValueError

findings.title: A remembered secret stayed in the OS credential store after it was forgotten or its profile deleted, when the profile file no longer held the store marker (moved to the file opt-in)
findings.fix: _forget_secret always deletes from the store (overwrites with nothing when refused); a file-kept secret deletes the store's older copy

findings.title: A profile store that was valid JSON of another shape (a list, profiles not a dict) crashed every profile call
findings.fix: _read checks the shape; a foreign shape reads as empty

findings.title: tenant_profiles.upsert used the request's profile id unchecked ('../../x', 5000 characters) as a store and credential-store key
findings.fix: An id that is neither stored nor a valid profile id is slugified

findings.title: A damaged rate-state file (a non-number, a list) made every paced request, preflight and hold raise
findings.fix: _clean_tenant keeps only finite numbers and known buckets; bad entries are dropped

findings.title: After the clock was set back, a paced write waited as long as the clock had moved (a day), not one window
findings.fix: Requests counted in the future are rebased to now in _delay

findings.title: zia_rate.hold accepted an infinite hold from a reset header (writes held for ever, Infinity in the state file)
findings.fix: hold_seconds: finite, 0..a week

findings.title: The rate wait message read the wall clock (datetime.now) instead of the injected clock
findings.fix: datetime.fromtimestamp(_now() + wait)

findings.title: Non-finite x-ratelimit headers raised OverflowError in note_headers
findings.fix: _header_num returns None for NaN/inf

findings.title: SdkClient.close() never ended the classic API's JSESSIONID session (the wrapper has no __exit__)
findings.fix: close() calls LegacyZiaClient.close (deauthenticate)

findings.title: SdkClient logged and returned SDK error text unmasked (an echoed Bearer token or the client secret)
findings.fix: _sdk_call redacts tokens; get() masks the client's own secrets in every error

findings.title: _sdk_call raised AttributeError for a callable without __name__; get() after a failed sign-in said "(False, '...')"
findings.fix: Name looked up safely; the reason itself is returned

findings.title: security.scrub_dict kept 6 characters and the length of each secret, and skipped dicts inside lists
findings.fix: Secret values become '[redacted]'; lists are walked

findings.title: A failed write of ui_token.txt left its temporary file, holding the token, behind
findings.fix: The temporary file is removed on any failure

findings.title: The API rate limiter used the wall clock: setting it back refused every /api call (429) for as long as the jump
findings.fix: Monotonic clock, no negative refill, last rebased on refusal

findings.title: tenant_fingerprint.same_tenant raised TypeError for a record whose tenant_fp has a non-ASCII character
findings.fix: compare_digest on bytes

findings.title: docs/SECURITY_TESTING.md is stale once tests/test_c6_auth.py is added (tests/test_security_test_matrix.py::test_the_standards_document_is_current fails); this agent may not edit the document or its generator
findings.fix: Resolved at integration: docs/SECURITY_TESTING.md was regenerated with python tools/security_test_matrix.py after the merges and is regenerated again on this branch
